info.name: Enterprise AI Agent Hub - Gateway API
info.description:
Covers every endpoint built through the agent-runtime sandbox + git integration (auth/register+login, user management + RBAC, platform API keys, vendor credential encryption, tool credential encryption, LLM ping + tool-calling, real sandboxed shell command execution, real sandboxed git clone) plus cross-tenant isolation checks. Run the whole collection top-to-bottom via the Collection Runner -- requests are ordered so variables (tokens, ids) flow from earlier requests into later ones. Re-running the full collection is safe; tenant slugs are regenerated each run.

The 'Agents' folder makes REAL calls to the Anthropic API (costs real credits -- set the collectionVariable 'anthropicApiKey' to a real key before running it, or expect those requests to fail with 502) AND real E2B sandbox executions via the sandbox sidecar (agent-runtime/sidecar/ must be running locally -- see its README -- or the shell-command/git-clone requests will fail with 502 too). Both failures are valid, testable outcomes if you haven't set those up. The git clone request targets a public repo, so no tool credential is required for it to succeed.

exec: pm.test('Role is ADMIN (first user of a new tenant)', () => pm.expect(json.role).to.eql('ADMIN'));
pm.test('Message explains the slug conflict', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Tenant slug already taken'));
pm.test('Message is generic (does not confirm the email exists)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid credentials'));
pm.test('Status is 401 Unauthorized (same as wrong password)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test('Message does not reveal the tenant is unknown', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid credentials'));
pm.test('Tenant has exactly admin + developer', () => pm.expect(json.length).to.eql(2));
pm.test('Status is 403 Forbidden (DEVELOPER cannot manage users)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
pm.test('Status is 403 Forbidden (no token at all)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

item.name: Acme Creates a Fresh API Key
Globex Cannot See Acme's API Key

exec: pm.test('Globex key list is empty (does not include Acme\'s key)', () => pm.expect(json.length).to.eql(0));

item.name: Globex Cannot Revoke Acme's API Key

exec: pm.test('Status is 404 Not Found (existence not confirmed or denied via 403)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
pm.test('Globex only sees its own single admin user', () => pm.expect(json.length).to.eql(1));
pm.test('That user belongs to Globex, not Acme', () => pm.expect(json[0].email).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('globexSlug')));
